AquaPure Trio KW-UF300
3-Stage Under-Sink Water Filtration System
USER MANUAL - Installation, Operation and Maintenance

Kettlewell Home Products
Please read this manual completely before installing. Keep it for future
reference.

1. IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
- Do not use with water that is microbiologically unsafe or of unknown
  quality without adequate disinfection before or after the system.
- Install on the cold water supply only. Hot water (above 100 °F / 38 °C)
  will damage the filter cartridges.
- Operating pressure: 30-100 psi. If your household pressure exceeds 100
  psi, install a pressure-reducing valve.
- Do not install where the unit may freeze or be exposed to direct
  sunlight.

2. WHAT'S IN THE BOX
A. Filter head assembly with mounting bracket (1)
B. Stage 1 sediment cartridge, 5 micron (gray label) (1)
C. Stage 2 carbon block cartridge (blue label) (1)
D. Stage 3 lead and cyst reduction cartridge (green label) (1)
E. Dedicated faucet, brushed nickel, with base plate (1)
F. 3/8" feed water adapter and shut-off valve (1)
G. 1/4" tubing, 15 ft (1)
H. Mounting screws (4) and housing wrench (1)

3. INSTALLATION
Step 1. Turn off the cold water supply under the sink and open the
kitchen faucet to release pressure.
Step 2. Install the feed water adapter (F) between the cold water valve
and the faucet supply line. Hand-tighten, then one half turn with a
wrench. Do not use thread sealant on compression fittings.
Step 3. Mount the filter head (A) on the cabinet wall with the screws,
leaving at least 3 inches below the housings for cartridge changes.
Step 4. Drill a 1/2" hole in the sink or countertop if no spare hole is
available, and mount the faucet (E).
Step 5. Cut the tubing (G) squarely and push it firmly into the quick-
connect fittings: adapter to "IN", "OUT" to faucet.
Step 6. Insert the three cartridges in order (gray, blue, green), turning
each one clockwise until it locks.
Step 7. Open the cold water supply slowly and check for leaks.

4. FIRST USE
Open the filter faucet and flush the system for 5 minutes. Small black
particles of carbon fines and a cloudy appearance are normal during the
first flush and will clear.

5. MAINTENANCE
Replace the cartridges according to this schedule, or sooner if the flow
rate drops noticeably:
- Stage 1 (sediment): every 6 months
- Stage 2 (carbon block): every 6 months or 750 gallons
- Stage 3 (lead and cyst): every 12 months or 1,500 gallons
The LED on the faucet base blinks red when 6 months have passed since the
last reset. After replacing cartridges, hold the button for 5 seconds to
reset the timer.

6. TROUBLESHOOTING
Low flow - Clogged sediment cartridge; replace Stage 1.
Leak at fitting - Tubing not fully inserted; cut squarely and reinsert.
Bad taste - Cartridges overdue or not flushed; replace and flush.
LED off - Replace the CR2032 battery in the faucet base.

7. LIMITED WARRANTY
Kettlewell Home Products warrants the filter head and faucet against
defects in materials and workmanship for 2 years from the date of
purchase. Cartridges are consumables and are not covered. Register your
product at kettlewellhome.example/register. Customer care: 1-800-555-0163,
Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-6 p.m. Central Time.
